options.content: **Verdicts live in benchlens, not here.** These panels show raw values, means and ranges straight from the benchlens database (SQLite has no median). Whether a difference is *better*, *worse* or *within noise* (medians, CV and vmbench's noise rule) is decided by benchlens only: [compare in benchlens](${benchlens_url}/?view=compare). Here, per group: **mean of all counted rounds of its runs** (pooled from `v_stats`), with min, max and n. benchlens compares **medians** and applies the noise rule; a gap between two means below is not a verdict.

panels.title: Pooled mean / min / max per metric and group

targets.queryText:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT s.section, s.id, s.name, s.unit, s.direction, s.grp,
         SUM(s.n) AS n, COUNT(*) AS runs,
         SUM(s.mean * s.n) / SUM(s.n) AS mean, MIN(s.min) AS min, MAX(s.max) AS max
  FROM v_stats s
  WHERE s.grp IN (${grp:sqlstring})
    AND s.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring})
    AND s.section IN (${section:sqlstring})
    AND s.id IN (${metric:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY s.id, s.grp
)
SELECT id AS metric, name, unit, direction, grp AS "group", runs, n, mean, min, max
FROM g ORDER BY id, grp
